tip.welcome: Each part of the day — morning, afternoon, night — you get one action. Earn some money under Earn, then spend it on food and water under Survive. If health reaches 0, this life is over.
tip.health_low: Your health is slipping. Visit a clinic or an NGO, rest, and don't let hunger or thirst run out — health at 0 ends the life.
tip.thirst_low: You're getting dehydrated. Buy water under Survive — thirst hurts your health faster than hunger.
tip.hunger_low: You're getting hungry. Buy a meal, or get free food from a charity kitchen.
tip.energy_low: You're nearly out of energy. Most work costs energy; rest in the shade or sleep to get it back.
tip.heat_high: The police are noticing you. Move to a spot with fewer police, or lie low for a while until it calms down.
tip.hope_low: Your hope is running low. Talk to people on the street, call your family, or play with your dog — it is hard to climb out without hope.
tip.hygiene_low: You're very dirty. People give less and you get sick more easily. Wash under Survive.
tip.first_night: It's night. Sleeping restores energy. A shelter bed is safer than sleeping rough, especially in rain or cold.
tip.skip: You can now skip ahead a week at a time with the buttons below the cards. Pick a style of living; it stops for anything important.
tip.way_out: The main way off the street: save money, get an ID card, find steady work, then rent a room — all under Future. There are other, hidden ways out too.

help.title: How to play
help.day.title: The day
help.day.1: Every day has three parts: morning, afternoon and night. You get one action in each, and the day moves on after it.
help.day.2: Actions are sorted into Earn, Survive, People and Future. Most cost energy, some cost money, and some only work in certain places or at certain times. A locked card tells you what it needs.
help.stats.title: Your stats
help.stat.health: if it reaches 0, this life ends. It drops when you are starving, thirsty, sick or hurt.
help.stat.hunger: how full you are. Keep it up with meals or charity food.
help.stat.thirst: how much water you have had. Falls faster than hunger and hurts health sooner.
help.stat.hygiene: dirty people get less help and fall sick more easily. Wash when you can.
help.stat.hope: your will to keep going. Low hope makes everything harder; people and small kindnesses lift it.
help.stat.energy: spent by work, restored by rest and sleep.
help.stat.rep: how the street knows you. Higher rep opens doors with other people.
help.stat.heat: police attention. High heat means fines, being moved on, or arrest. Lie low or change spots.
help.out.title: Getting out
help.out.1: The usual road: save money, get an ID card, find steady work, then rent a room. These are under Future.
help.out.2: There are other, hidden endings too, good and bad. Random events will test you along the way.
help.keys.title: Keyboard
help.key.card: do the n-th action in the open tab
